$:set -eu
tmp=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
cat > "$tmp" <<'__FEATURE_EXTRACTION_TASK_JSON__'
{
  "task_type": "babel_function_feature_extraction_and_functional_classification",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "status": "pending",
  "source_request": "Write up your extraction suggestion as a task in root tasks",
  "task": {
    "objective": "Extract source-backed structural, data-flow, call/dependency and effect features for every function definition in the pinned JavaScript inventory; use these features to group functionally similar implementations and classify behavior without equating Babel syntax or names with semantics.",
    "execution_requested_now": false,
    "repository": "BestNameYet/Terminals",
    "source_inventory": {
      "inventory_root": "workspaces/repository-file-inventory-20261109/",
      "collector": "workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/collect-expressions.js",
      "grouped_identifiers": "workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/identifiers-members.json",
      "grouped_function_pairs": "workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/enclosing-function-name-type-pairs.json",
      "parser_spec": "references/babel-parser-ast-spec.md",
      "libraries": [
        "@babel/parser",
        "@babel/traverse",
        "@babel/types"
      ],
      "extraction_runs": [
        42573859935,
        42573703776,
        42573862688,
        42573864857,
        42573867528,
        42573869494,
        42573871895,
        42573874240,
        42573876389
      ],
      "baseline": {
        "repositories": 9,
        "files_in_inventory": 774,
        "javascript_files": 321,
        "successfully_parsed_js_files": 319,
        "failed_js_files": 2,
        "extracted_expressions": 265283,
        "distinct_enclosing_function_name_type_pairs": 976,
        "distinct_nonnull_function_names": 931
      },
      "scope": "All inventoried JS files at their recorded pinned source revisions; preserve parse failures and source-byte verification. No unannounced sampling or substitution with newer HEAD revisions."
    },
    "classification_unit": {
      "primary": "Individual function definition identified by repository, revision, relative file path, and AST source span.",
      "included_forms": [
        "FunctionDeclaration",
        "FunctionExpression",
        "ArrowFunctionExpression",
        "ObjectMethod",
        "ClassMethod",
        "ClassPrivateMethod",
        "other Babel function-like nodes enabled by the parser"
      ],
      "names": "Retain explicit, inferred, and null names. Preserve separate definitions with the same name.",
      "nesting": "Record parent/child function identity; separate operations directly in the function body from those inside nested functions and callbacks.",
      "aggregation": "Group by (enclosing_function_name, enclosing_function_type) as secondary analysis, not as a unique function identifier; reconcile against all 976 existing pairs and null/outside-function cases."
    },
    "feature_categories": [
      {
        "category": "signature",
        "extract": [
          "Babel definition type, name and naming context",
          "parameter count and parameter AST patterns (rest/default/destructuring)",
          "async, generator, method kind and static/private flags",
          "return and yield shape",
          "source span and containing function identity"
        ]
      },
      {
        "category": "operations",
        "extract": [
          "exact AST expression node types and counts",
          "arithmetic, logical, comparison, unary, assignment and update operators",
          "call/new expression structures and argument counts",
          "object/array/template construction",
          "member-expression chains, computed/optional property access"
        ]
      },
      {
        "category": "data_flow",
        "extract": [
          "parameter/local/captured/global identifier reads",
          "lexically resolved assignments and writes",
          "mutated bindings and object properties",
          "returned values and input-to-output dependencies where resolvable",
          "unresolved data-flow and alias uncertainty"
        ]
      },
      {
        "category": "control_flow",
        "extract": [
          "conditions, switches, loops, conditional expressions",
          "early returns, throws, try/catch/finally",
          "await and yield sites",
          "branch/loop nesting and directly evidenced flow metrics"
        ]
      },
      {
        "category": "dependencies",
        "extract": [
          "statically known direct call targets and imports",
          "callee/member access paths and imported aliases",
          "callback and nested-call relationships",
          "dynamic, computed and indirect call identities left unresolved where necessary"
        ]
      },
      {
        "category": "effects",
        "extract": [
          "local/shared state mutation",
          "file input/output and network calls",
          "process execution and interprocess operations",
          "console/output/event emission",
          "other externally observable effects",
          "evidence and explicit unknowns when behavior cannot be statically established"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "ordered_tasks": [
      {
        "id": "FEAT-01",
        "action": "Verify governing repository instructions, source inventories, source hashes, pinned revisions, Babel parser configuration, and coverage baseline."
      },
      {
        "id": "FEAT-02",
        "action": "Reparse each inventoried JavaScript file and enumerate every function-like AST definition, including anonymous and nested definitions; assign stable identities and hierarchy."
      },
      {
        "id": "FEAT-03",
        "action": "Extract all six feature categories via Babel node fields, traversal and lexical scope/binding analysis; preserve source evidence and unknowns; distinguish direct vs nested-body observations."
      },
      {
        "id": "FEAT-04",
        "action": "Link function definitions to existing expression, identifier/member and name/type inventories; produce feature vectors and comprehensive per-definition and aggregate records; preserve zero-expression functions."
      },
      {
        "id": "FEAT-05",
        "action": "Identify similarities using calls/member paths, data flow, effects, operators and control flow; use names only as supporting evidence; classify multi-label behaviors such as computation, transformation, validation, mutation, I/O and orchestration. Keep raw features independent from inferred labels."
      },
      {
        "id": "FEAT-06",
        "action": "Test and reconcile complete file/function coverage, source identities, aggregation, nested scope boundaries, unresolved dynamics and classification evidence against a manually reviewed reference set; persist outputs and independently verify readback."
      }
    ],
    "output_contract": {
      "per_function": {
        "function_id": "stable source identity",
        "repository": "owner/repository",
        "source_revision": "pinned SHA",
        "file_path": "relative path",
        "source_span": "start/end offsets and positions",
        "enclosing_function_name": "string or null",
        "enclosing_function_type": "Babel node type",
        "parent_function_id": "ID or null",
        "signature": "structured definition metadata",
        "features": "six feature category objects",
        "evidence": "AST types, locations, resolved references, uncertainty"
      },
      "datasets": [
        "Per-function machine-readable feature inventory",
        "Combined and per-name/type aggregate index linked to function identities",
        "Call and dependency references and unresolved-analysis diagnostics",
        "Separately versioned functional similarity groups and multi-label classifications",
        "Coverage/error manifest, parser settings, source revisions and tests"
      ]
    },
    "guardrails": [
      "Do not equate AST declaration type or matching function names with functional equivalence.",
      "Do not treat source occurrence counts as runtime execution frequency.",
      "Do not assert absence of side effects for unresolved calls.",
      "Do not aggregate nested callbacks into the parent function's direct operation counts.",
      "No revision to the planned JSON runtime action vocabulary is required by this extraction task.",
      "No source repo mutations, workflow deployments or runtime changes without explicit separate authorization."
    ],
    "acceptance": [
      "Every parseable JS file and function-like definition at the pinned revisions is covered, including anonymous and nested functions and those with zero recorded expressions.",
      "Every definition has a unique source-based identity and separately attributable features.",
      "All six feature categories are extracted with evidence or explicit unresolved markers.",
      "Definitions are reconciled against the 976 prior name/type pairs; null name/type/outside-function cases and all omissions or errors are explained.",
      "Output and clustering are reproducible; classification labels are distinguished from static observations and evaluated against manual review.",
      "Results are persisted with verifiable readback; the task remains pending until implementation and validation are actually completed."
    ],
    "output_location": "workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/",
    "execution_boundary": "Record task only. Do not run feature extraction as part of task authoring."
  }
}
__FEATURE_EXTRACTION_TASK_JSON__
python3 - "$tmp" <<'PY'
import sys,json,pathlib,datetime,hashlib,base64,subprocess
from urllib.parse import quote
task=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
assert task['task_type']=='babel_function_feature_extraction_and_functional_classification'
assert len(task['task']['feature_categories'])==6
assert len(task['task']['ordered_tasks'])==6
assert task['task']['execution_requested_now'] is False
assert task['status']=='pending'
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
task['created_at_utc']=now.isoformat(timespec='seconds').replace('+00:00','Z')
dest='Tasks/User Prompt Task Queue/user-prompt-task-'+str(int(now.timestamp()))+'.json'
data=(json.dumps(task,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
endpoint='repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/'+quote(dest,safe='/')
check=subprocess.run(['gh','api',endpoint],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
if check.returncode==0:raise RuntimeError('Destination already exists '+dest)
if '404' not in check.stderr and 'Not Found' not in check.stderr:raise RuntimeError(check.stderr)
obj={'message':'Queue comprehensive Babel function feature extraction study',
     'branch':'main','content':base64.b64encode(data).decode()}
r=subprocess.run(['gh','api','--method','PUT',endpoint,'--input','-'],
                 input=json.dumps(obj),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Write failed: '+r.stderr)
commit=json.loads(r.stdout)['commit']['sha']
read=subprocess.run(['gh','api',endpoint],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=90)
actual=base64.b64decode(json.loads(read.stdout)['content'])
assert actual==data
print(json.dumps({'verified':True,'path':dest,'commit':commit,'bytes':len(data),
                  'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'status':task['status']}))
PY
